sources: Pokemon Showdown (base stats, abilities, moves baseline, learnsets, type chart)
Serebii.net Champions pages (move corrections, new abilities, mega abilities)

verification.description: Each entry has a championsVerified boolean. True = confirmed against in-game Champions data. False = using Showdown/Gen 9 baseline, may differ in Champions.
verification.overridePattern: For moves, championsOverride contains confirmed Champions values. Apps should use override values when present, fall back to baseline otherwise.
